mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority or national civil registry of the relevant country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if originating state is an HCCH Contracting Party; otherwise Consular Legalization through a Vanuatu diplomatic or consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated financial institution in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming account conduct and source of funds

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence must be completed before incorporation. Every proposed shareholder, director, nominee, and ultimate beneficial owner is screened against the United Nations Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, and the VFSC public warnings and disqualification notices. Politically exposed persons are subject to enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and verification of source of wealth and funds. Continuous monitoring obligations apply after registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Companies Registry - International Company Name Search
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered company names must be expressed in Latin script using standard English or French spelling. Chinese characters, diacritics, or non-Latin transliterations are not accepted as the legal name. The name may be registered in English or French but must comply with the International Companies Act and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing VFSC-registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a proposed name is rejected, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the VFSC Registry within 14 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the legal basis for eligibility and may propose a modified name. The VFSC Registry must determine the appeal within 10 business days. A name reservation may be extended for a further 30 days by filing the prescribed extension form and payment of the extension fee before expiry of the original reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is acceptable for the statutory registered office requirement when provided by a licensed VFSC registered agent at a physical address in Port Vila. However, a virtual office cannot satisfy the substantive operational premises required for a regulated UN38.3 battery safety testing laboratory or the physical presence expectations of ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation, CE-RED electromagnetic compatibility testing, or any Vanuatu business licence related to dangerous goods testing. The testing laboratory must maintain a real operational facility in an appropriate jurisdiction.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For a standard Vanuatu International Company in the exempt zone, the annual probability of an unannounced VFSC inspection is low, estimated at below 5%. If VFSC performs an AML/CFT inspection, the registered agent's office is subject to on-site verification. For a regulated UN383/CE-RED testing laboratory, scheduled and unannounced inspections by VFSC, Vanuatu Department of Energy, and any applicable health and safety authorities are more likely, with a first-24-month inspection probability of approximately 30%.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), as amended; ss. 4 (Constitution and Memorandum), 5 (Registration), 13 (Directors), 22 (Registered Office and Agent), and 27 (Exemption from Tax)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company, submitted via VFSC Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement under the International Companies Act. The company may issue one or more shares without par value; a prudential working capital of no less than USD 50,000 for laboratory accreditation and insurance is recommended but not statutorily mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the share subscription of the sole incorporator is accepted, and the initial shares are allotted as recorded in the register of members; (2) the registered office at Port Vila, Vanuatu, as designated by the registered agent, is adopted, and the registered agent is authorised to file all statutory notices; (3) the following officers are appointed: Director/Chief Executive Officer and Company Secretary, each authorised to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and instruct professional advisers; (4) the officers are directed to apply for all required laboratory, industrial, and civil-defence licences and permits; and (5) any one director may certify copies of this resolution and corporate records. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online name reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation request through the VFSC e-portal or by submitting a signed Name Reservation Form to the Registry of International Companies, specifying the proposed company name ending with 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. Ensure the name does not conflict with existing VFSC-registered entities or protected names. The name is valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Completed VFSC Name Reservation Form
Copy of passport of the applicant or corporate authorised signatory
Certificate of incorporation of the corporate subscriber if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried due to similarity, submit an alternative name or file a formal appeal with VFSC Registry within 14 days, providing consent from the conflicting entity or evidence of coexistence rights.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and VFSC licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator must execute a Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, stating the company name, share structure, registered office in Vanuatu, and the licensed registered agent. The registered agent will conduct a due-diligence review and countersign the documents.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed and dated)
Subscriber's written consent to become a member and director
Registered agent's engagement letter and customer due-diligence form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC returns the documents for amendment, the registered agent must correct the defect within 5 business days and re-submit; any fee difference is credited to the applicant's account or applied as an offset.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and payment of fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File VFSC Form 1 together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and pay the prescribed government fee of USD 350 via wire transfer or VFSC e-payment platform. Include a cover letter confirming the company's proposed business purpose under ISIC 7120 (battery safety testing and laboratory services).
required_dossiers: Completed VFSC Form 1
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Proof of name reservation
Payment confirmation (USD 350)
Registered agent's due-diligence certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incomplete information, submit the requested clarifications or corrected forms within 10 business days; VFSC will continue processing without re-imposing the registration fee. If refusal is issued, the applicant may request a written reason and seek administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and files any subsequent statutory documents, including the first director and registered agent notification.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate issued by VFSC
List of first directors and members (if not stated in Memorandum)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate issuance is delayed, contact VFSC Registry by email and request expedited release; if there is a typographical error, submit an application for correction with supporting evidence at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of registered agent and registered office confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent and execute a registered office agreement. The agent will maintain the registered office at a physical address in Vanuatu, accept service of process, and keep the statutory register if delegated. The agent also files the notice of registered office and agent change with VFSC.
required_dossiers: Registered agent agreement
Appointment of registered agent resolution
Consent of the registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws consent, the company must appoint a replacement within the statutory time frame; VFSC may be notified via Form 33 by the outgoing agent or the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation corporate governance and tax exemption confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt the pro forma resolution, issue share certificates, open a corporate bank account, and request a tax exemption certificate from the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue confirming the company's status as an International Company exempt from Vanuatu income tax. Maintain the company seal and statutory registers at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Bank account opening forms (for board approval)
Tax exemption application form
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption certificate is delayed, file a reminder and attach a copy of the Incorporation Certificate; if the bank account application is rejected, the board may approve onboarding with an alternative payment-rail provider such as Wise or a bank accepting IBC structures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Department of Energy (Energy Regulation Unit), together with the Vanuatu Metrology and Standards Laboratory where applicable
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Laboratory Operations Permit for Dangerous Goods Testing (UN38.3) and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) Laboratory

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) of the Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Registration (Low Environmental Risk); mandatory environmental registration required before operation due to handling of lithium battery test articles
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Submit a Waste Management and Hazardous Substances Handling Plan covering battery electrolyte spills; comply with discharge limits for chemical oxygen demand (COD) below 100 mg/L and total suspended solids (TSS) below 50 mg/L, and ensure VOC emissions from test fumigation equipment are below 40 mg/m³. All contaminated battery waste must be segregated and exported only to a permitted recycling facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain a Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu National Fire Service, a Building Inspection Certificate for structural load on test chamber floors, and an Occupational Health and Safety clearance for electrical test equipment. Test-area ventilation must meet 10 air changes per hour, and emergency eyewash installations are required in the battery-testing room.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; customs and fiscal portal: https://customs.gov.vu. International Company incorporation and annual exemption compliance are administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through licensed registered agents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company: (1) instruct a VFSC-licensed registered agent to incorporate the IC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; (2) apply to VCIR for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, and the registered agent's confirmation letter; (3) pay the one-off government registration fee and the annual exemption/registration fee to VFSC. No income tax registration or tax return filing obligation arises because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, VAT, GST, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. The International Companies Act (Cap. 222) confers a statutory, non-elective tax exemption; no check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or fiscal consolidation elections are available or required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - Vanuatu levies no VAT, GST, or sales tax; only border-type charges (customs import duty, port and service levies) apply to physical imports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. There is no turnover-based indirect tax registration threshold because Vanuatu imposes no VAT, GST, or sales tax on domestic supplies or services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping mandate exists for this regime. Customs border declarations are processed electronically through the Vanuatu ASYCUDA World system; ordinary commercial invoices, packing lists, and laboratory test reports are accepted.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. As Vanuatu levies no VAT/GST, there is no zero-rating claim for exported battery safety laboratory services or re-exported UN38.3 test samples. Exports remain outside any indirect tax charge, and no tax repayment mechanism arises.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration generated in ASYCUDA World
Commercial invoice referencing the UN38.3 test protocol
Packing list identifying battery samples, quantities, and UN3480/UN3481 classification
Bill of lading or airway bill
Inward remittance record or bank transfer confirmation of test fees
UN38.3 test report or certificate of analysis
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback or zero-rating penalty regime exists. However, false declarations or fraudulent export documents submitted to VCIR attract penalties under the Customs Act (fines up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment, plus forfeiture of goods); false statements or omissions in VFSC filings attract penalties of up to VT 10,000,000 and/or 12 months' imprisonment under the International Companies Act. No statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline applies.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 278], is the central bank and the sole authority for monetary policy, currency issuance, foreign exchange licensing, and the prudential supervision of all licensed banks and credit institutions in Vanuatu. The RBV also acts as the national AML/CFT supervisor under the Financial Services Providers (Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism) Act and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has no comprehensive exchange control statute requiring Central Bank approval for ordinary payments. The vatu is fully convertible for current account purposes, and capital account flows by and into International Companies are generally free from non-RBV approval requirements. Profit remittance and shareholder dividend distributions are permissible without exchange control authorization provided all internal accounts are finalized, domestic statutory fees are settled, the corporate resolution is approved, and the receiving bank completes standard source-of-funds compliance. Practical constraints arise not from convertibility restrictions but from bank-level AML due diligence and sanctions screening, plus the limited depth of the domestic onshore FX market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory requirement for conversion, surrender, or mandatory repatriation of export proceeds. For the UN38.3 battery testing laboratory, service receipts in USD or other foreign currencies may be settled and retained in multi-currency business accounts at a Vanuatu licensed bank. There is no minimum percentage that must be exchanged into VUV. The only prudential expectation is that all export service receipts are received through a licensed financial institution and supported by a signed testing agreement and invoice containing a valid harmorized system or purpose-of-payment description, which should use the equivalent of 'professional and technical testing services'. No export declaration to the Customs Service is required because the output is a certification test report.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operational Account (VUV/USD/AUD) plus separate Capital Escrow Account for initial injected registered capital
Operational Corporate Account and Trade Settlement Account
VUV and USD Operational Account for local regulatory fees and domestic payroll
Foreign-Currency Treasury Account and Disbursement Account for capital expenditures

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium as a substitute for full treasury operations. Wise and similar unlicensed fintech EMIs are not licensed or regulated by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu and cannot provide a local Vanuatu account number, local vatu clearing capability, or Vanuatu regulatory standing. Wise may be used in the early stage only as an auxiliary payment method for small incidental deposits or supplier payments, operated from an external USD account. It is not acceptable as the primary inbound capital clearing rail because the RBV reporting framework and local bank onboarding require the first layer of funding to pass through a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Fully remote account opening is not accepted by licensed Vanuatu banks for non-resident International Companies. At least one authorized director and the ultimate beneficial owner must be physically present before, or conduct an approved live video interview with, a bank compliance officer. For directors unable to travel, the standard accepted alternative is an in-person oath and identity verification administered by a Vanuatu-licensed notary or registered agent followed by bank acceptance of the notarized certificate. The registered agent in Vanuatu must also attend or provide a due diligence attestation regarding the beneficial ownership structure. No pure e-KYC with only email-transmitted passports is accepted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or shareholders residing in high-risk or opaque jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of each director's passport and second government-issued ID; notarized proof of residential address; professional reference from an attorney or chartered accountant; and standard source-of-wealth declaration executed in front of a Vanuatu registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company ownership structure perceived as bearer-share or nominee-controlled
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified memorandum of association; contemporaneous share register and share transfer ledger; notarized beneficial ownership statement identifying all natural persons holding over 10%; issued share certificates matched to the current shareholder record; confirmation from the Vanuatu registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection appears disproportionate to a lab-services balance sheet or unrelated to battery testing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed equipment purchase agreements for thermal chambers and drop-test rigs; formal UN38.3 methodology manual; forecast testing pipeline with client letters of intent; detailed use-of-funds budget and a two-year cash-flow projection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: One-off incoming wiring from a shareholder residing in China or a private payment service provider
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statement of the remitting shareholder showing a natural accumulation path; source-of-funds affidavit and tax clearance summary; annotated SWIFT MT103 copy; explanation of the commercial purpose in the laboratory's service agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high inbound volume from foreign testing clients paid via third-party payment gateways rather than direct bank wires
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client contract list, payment gateway processing agreement, projected transaction volumes, outbreak of beneficial client KYC, and a group AML policy aligned with FATF recommendations; advice to maintain direct SWIFT settlement whenever possible.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial capital injection should be routed by SWIFT MT103 wire transfer from the shareholder's foreign account to the Capital Escrow Account opened at the first-tier domestic bank. The payment field must carry a clear purpose code — 'capital injection into International Company' or 'paid-in share capital — balance of payments item DI/equity' — and the narrative should include the exact corporate name and the phrase 'formation capital for licensed UN38.3 testing laboratory'. The bank requires pre-submission of the certified share register, incorporation certificate, approved corporate resolution, and source-of-funds dossier. All future shareholder subordinated loans or equity injections must use separate transfer references and updated corporate resolutions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for acquisition of battery testing equipment, thermal test machinery, calibration instruments, and laboratory consumables should use direct SWIFT MT103 payments from the foreign-currency treasury account to the supplier's bank. A commercial letter of credit may be applied when the supplier requires irrevocable payment security for capital equipment above the bank's pre-approved threshold, in which case the issuing bank will require a copy of the purchase contract and pro forma invoice. No export bill of collection is required because the laboratory's deliverable is a digital testing report and type certificate. Utilization of the USD clearing rail via New York correspondents and AUD/EUR rails via correspondent banks is permissible, subject to sanctions screening on counterparties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank when the laboratory has a firm near-term USD receivable and needs to fix the vatu value of a health- and safety-fund or local regulatory fee in vatu

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on VUV/USD executed with a non-resident bank counterparty where Vanuatu domestic parties are limited to borrowing and neither side enters into onshore VUV settlement, subject to bank AML review

USD/AUD cross-currency swap through a licensed credit institution to hedge the equipment or lease exposure denominated in Australian dollars, where the underlying transaction is a battery test-chamber purchase, and where the swap is booked without leverage and with full collateral documentation

Standalone currency options and barrier structures are not recommended and generally not offered by domestic Vanuatu banks; any negotiable or structured hedging product would require express Foreign Exchange Prudential Committee notification to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu before execution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Existence Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date; payable on or before the anniversary, with a 30-day administrative grace period before penalty accrual
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a prescribed surcharge of 10% of the annual fee; if unpaid for six consecutive months, VFSC may initiate strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1992.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent's Annual Compliance Declaration confirming current directors, members, beneficial owners, and registered office details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file is treated as an AML/CFT compliance breach; the registered agent is exposed to licence suspension and the company may be flagged for administrative strike-off if the agent is deregistered.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a Vanuatu International Company; no revenue, asset, or shareholder thresholds require audit. A voluntary audit may be resolved by the members, or VFSC may require one for a regulated activity such as banking, insurance, or securities dealing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for voluntarily prepared or audited financial statements; the International Companies Act does not prescribe a separate local statutory GAAP for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A Vanuatu International Company is not subject to a public annual UBO filing. Beneficial ownership records are maintained confidentially at the registered office. The registered agent performs an annual customer-due-diligence refresh and, upon any shareholding transfer, updates the beneficial ownership register and obtains a signed beneficial-owner declaration confirming current ownership details.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – USD 700 per year for licensed registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (statutorily exempt); voluntary certified audit for a small testing laboratory typically USD 3,000 – USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory corporate income tax; International Company income is wholly exempt from Vanuatu income tax; no income tax holiday or preferential deduction regime applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Licence Renewal (International Company) – filed via VFSC e-services or through the company's registered agent in Vanuatu; no corporate income tax return exists under Vanuatu law.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Payable on or before the anniversary date of incorporation; penalty accrues for late payment after the anniversary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique International Company registration number as shown on the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owner must quote the exact IC number; a simple copy of the certificate suffices, no notarisation required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company is not carrying on any local business in Vanuatu and is operating exclusively offshore. For the target lab, this covers ISIC 7120 battery safety and UN38.3 drop-testing services rendered from outside Vanuatu or for non-resident clients.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick 'Offshore services only'; confirm that no revenue arises from Vanuatu domestic customers and no office/physical presence is maintained in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The duly licensed registered agent in Vanuatu attests to the company's legal existence, annual fee compliance, and records custody.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a Vanuatu-licensed agent signs, no additional foreign apostille or notarial block is needed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to renew by the anniversary attracts monthly late penalties (standard VFSC penalty tariff), suspension of the licence, and eventual striking-off of the company. Reinstatement after strike-off involves substantial restitution payments to the VFSC.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose withholding tax on dividend distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no dividend withholding tax, so no DTA relief mechanism or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) submission is required. If a foreign payer asks for proof of Vanuatu residence, the registered agent may issue a Certificate of Good Standing or a company status letter; TRCs are generally not issued because Vanuatu does not levy income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% effective under any treaty; Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on royalties or interest paid to non-residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore no statutory transfer pricing documentation thresholds in local currency (VUV).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations (2022) apply to International Companies carrying on 'relevant activities'. Battery safety testing and CE-RED electromagnetic lab testing under ISIC 7120 is not a listed relevant activity; however, an IC must not maintain any local taxable presence without approval. A tangible lab operated inside Vanuatu could trigger licensing and substance scrutiny. Non-resident owners must maintain a registered agent and file any annual declarations required by the VFSC to preserve offshore status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring zero local activity when the lab actually performs testing on goods physically present in Vanuatu, or invoicing domestic Vanuatu clients while claiming full offshore exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties and criminal fines under the Value Added Tax Act (No. 8 of 1998) and International Companies Act; maximum penalties may include fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 7 years for deliberate tax fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers may be personally liable for unpaid taxes, penalties and restitution; a director may be subjected to a travel ban, asset seizure, or imprisonment for knowingly filing false declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Commercial Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a mere 'letterbox' IC with no human resources, premises, or equipment while holding out as a licensed battery safety testing laboratory; material misrepresentation in VFSC compliance filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Economic Substance Regulations (2022), the VFSC may impose an annual fine up to VUV 50,000, deregister the company, and exchange information with foreign tax authorities; intentional misstatement can also be prosecuted in the Vanuatu Magistrates' Court.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a substance-deficient IC may be disqualified from acting as directors in Vanuatu for up to five years, fined personally, and/or subjected to a travel ban pending the conclusion of a VFSC inquiry.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the testing lab IC to move payments for clients in sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions without performing customer due diligence, or failing to appoint a Money Laundering Reporting Officer when the IC receives or transmits regulated funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (No. 18 of 2014) carry severe fines and imprisonment up to 20 years for serious money laundering; the financial institution or registered agent may also face licence revocation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for AML breaches including confiscation of assets, personal fines, travel bans, and imprisonment; the corporate veil is pierced where the IC is proven to be a sham.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to renew the IC's annual licence or deliberate abandonment without formal liquidation, leaving tax and compliance records unmanaged for over 12 months.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Striking-off under the International Companies Act; all assets and rights of the struck-off international company vest in the Government of Vanuatu, and the company loses legal personality.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be liable for debts incurred after the expiry of the licence, may be barred from reincorporating in Vanuatu, and may face travel restrictions pending restoration of the company or discharge of outstanding liabilities.
